offerings.summary: High schoolers meet weekly with architects, engineers and construction professionals to design a real project as a team, and gain access to summer internships and scholarships.

loc.venue: Local schools and libraries in Baltimore

grades.raw: all students in 9th through 12th grade who are interested in pursuing careers in construction, architecture, engineering, interior design, landscape architecture, facilities management, and related fields

comp.raw: access to summer internships, $150,000 worth of scholarships, and other development opportunities

issues: The weekly sessions are a mentored design project rather than assigned duties inside an organization, which sits on the P01 boundary. The linked summer internships would be in scope; the mentoring season on its own needs an owner decision.
Internships and scholarships are described as access, not as compensation for the mentoring season

sources.title: Join as a Student - ACE Mentor of Baltimore
